playedGameDefinition.predicate: played if parsed minutes > 0, or minutes token is "0"/"0.0" (sub-minute appearance), or minutes==0 with box-score activity; else DNP if numeric zero (typically "00"); malformed otherwise
playedGameDefinition.targetUniverse: Final games with parsed minutes > 0 (same scoring universe as the prior minutes experiment)
playedGameDefinition.dnpConvention: analytics.player_game_logs.minutes = "00" is the DNP/inactive roster row; no DNP-CD/inactive flags exist on this table
playedGameDefinition.countingCurrent: mean over last N Final logs including DNP zeros (production Track A semantics)
playedGameDefinition.countingPlayed: mean over last N played games (0-point played games included)
playedGameDefinition.aggregateRate: sum(stat) / sum(minutes) over played games with minutes > 0
playedGameDefinition.meanGameRate: mean(stat/minutes) over played games with minutes > 0

formulas.aggregateRate: sum(stat)/sum(minutes) on played games with minutes>0
